EADM invites submissions for its

<a href="http://www.iese.edu/en/events/OtrosEventos/SPUDM24/Home/Home.asp"><strong>2013 Biennial SPUDM24 conference</strong></a>

SPUDM24 will be held at IESE Business School, Barcelona, Spain from 18-22 August 2013. The organizing committee is pleased to announce that the conference will feature the following invited speakers: Timothy D. Wilson, Colin F. Camerer, Robin Hogarth, and Ralph Hertwig. For call for papers and submissions, please visit the <a href="http://www.iese.edu/en/events/OtrosEventos/SPUDM24/Home/Home.asp">SPUDM24 website.</a>
